description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CACI International Inc is hiring a Front End Software Developer to build and maintain next-generation mission management applications. The role focuses on developing user interfaces and cloud-native microservices, writing automated tests, and supporting deployment and troubleshooting in an agile team.
Front-End Software Developer developing mission management web applications and interfaces, supporting cloud-native microservices and automated testing

Responsibilities:
• The ideal candidate will have a strong background in TypeScript and experience with front-end technologies. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining web applications, ensuring a seamless user experience
• As a developer on this exciting and dynamic program; you will bring your software development experience and perspective to work within a multi disciplined agile team in designing, developing, and maintaining next generation mission management applications
• We’ll look to you to help develop, troubleshoot, and maintain cloud native microservices and a user interface (UI) for a data-rich application with complex user workflows
• As a part of the development process and supporting user adoption, you will write automated tests against your code, deploy to a fully automated DevSecOps pipeline, and help troubleshoot any bugs found
• Each day, you can expect to report a brief status at an agile stand-up meeting, dig into the highest priority work to accomplish that day, code with your teammates, and participate in TEMs as needed

Requirements:
• 0-3 years in software development
• Clearance: Must have TS/SCI with CI poly (or be willing to take CI poly)
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• Proficiency in JavaScript and its frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js)
• Strong understanding of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
• Familiarity with RESTful APIs and websockets
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Willingness to work within true Agile Kanban processes and dynamic development environments
• Demonstrated experience working with others in a team environment
• Current Security+ certification (or the willingness to get it)

Preferred:
• Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps processes and tools
• Experience using Amazon Web Services
• Experience with container management tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
• Experience with Git / GitLab source code management tools
• Experience using Test Driven Development (TDD) tools such as Cypress and Mockito
• Experience with database systems such as MySQL, Redis, etc
• Willingness to be Fullstack
